Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling game distant background plate, 1792x1024 landscape. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its premium detailed pixel-art rendering, crisp painted pixels and nighttime depth, but create a completely different OUTDOOR Rio de Janeiro location.
Primary request: a rich blue/teal night panorama of Rio seen from a waterfront car-meet overlook. Deep navy clear night sky filling upper 45%, layered distant dark mountain silhouettes, dense hillside neighborhoods and waterfront towers with scattered warm amber windows in lower half, subtle magenta and turquoise city lights, calm dark bay. Atmospheric perspective: distant details subdued, not sharp foreground clutter. A few faint stars, no giant moon. Lowest 15% quiet dark teal/navy silhouettes, to sit behind a separate street layer.
Critical exclusions: NO Christ statue here (a separate landmark layer will add it), no cars, no people, no street, no palm trees in foreground, no text, no UI, no gym, no watermark. Panoramic side-on view, not a road receding to a central vanishing point. Both left/right edges must have matching horizon height, dark palette and inconspicuous skyline shapes to repeat horizontally. Fully rendered real raster game art, not vector, not photoreal, not a flat silhouette placeholder.
